title: poterium sanguisorba subvar. vulcanorum
intro: Poterium sanguisorba subvar. vulcanorum, commonly known as alder sanguisorba, is a subspecies of the Poterium sanguisorba plant, a type of flowering plant in the rose family (Rosaceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and diuretic properties. The therapeutic actions of alder sanguisorba include its ability to act as a hemostatic agent, helping to stop bleeding, and as a diuretic, promoting urine production and reducing fluid retention. The bioactive constituents of alder sanguisorba include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
